title: Plant Protection and Vector Control Equipment - Fogging Machines, Part 2: Air-Blower Type Thermal Fogger
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies material, constructional, performance and other requirements and method of test of air-blower type thermal fogger.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Crop Protection Equipment - Glossary of Terms
Plant Protection and Vector Control Equipment - Fogging Machines, Part 1: Pulse-Jet-Type Thermal Fogger

clause_3_terminology: Plant Protection and Vector Control Equipment

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
